Runtime Governance

PHP Lifecycle, Configuration Drift & Recovery

Menu: System & Agent Health > Runtime Governance & Configuration Evidence.
  1. Install or update PHP: Apply the generator values globally for that version. Automatic onboarding/repair waits for stable observations, matching reviewed settings and successful preflight. Maintenance Mode pauses background governance.
  2. Review differences: Choose Refresh Evidence. Expected/actual settings, account INI exceptions and per-section coverage are displayed. Incomplete scans and sections not checked are labelled; no differences is not full deployment certification.
  3. Retry after fixing a cause: Choose Reconcile PHP Changes. This resets retry history without bypassing safety checks.
  4. Uninstall PHP: Move its sites first, then choose Retire Runtime and confirm successful retirement before removing software in Webuzo. Enable Runtime permits registration again. Missing files or remaining pools block unsafe retirement.
  5. Investigate busy responses: Read Capacity Events and Recent Capacity Event Timeline. These are bounded journal events, not unique visitors; account limits, shared budget and queues can have different causes.
  6. Recover or export: Use Recover Pending Operation for an interrupted lifecycle transaction, or Prepare & Download Comparison for private diagnostics. Failed recovery retains its journal. Exports contain account paths; share privately.
Native PHP-FPM defaults remain global; automatic account runtime caps borrow available shared capacity rather than reserving workers for idle accounts. Tuning values come from the reviewed generator profile, not this help page.
